note: Approved decorative or brand SVG exceptions only; functional icons must use lucide-react. Raw colors are a shrinking legacy ceiling, not permission for new values. SaZones.tsx holds the zone polygon canvas: it is a data graphic the SA edits, not an icon, and it stays on a schematic 0..100 grid so no external map tile is needed. DonutChart.tsx holds the Ringkasan donut: arcs need SVG stroke-dasharray, and it is a data graphic, not an icon; bars in the same dashboard are plain HTML/CSS. HomePromoCarousel.tsx holds the promo-card background waves and dot texture: the same decorative motif as the home hero, opacity kept at 4-14%, not functional icons. CurrencyExchangeIcon.tsx holds the currency-exchange glyph: the EDISI 02 design source uses Google's Material Symbols "currency_exchange" (precise circle + dollar + circulation arrows) and no lucide icon is equivalent, so the owner approved it as a written brand exception for the currency button and converter sheet only. MerchantCoverage.tsx holds the merchant coverage editor canvas: the same schematic 0..100 grid as SaZones (no external map tile is allowed), a data graphic the merchant draws and validates, not an icon.
